Marco Mazzotta

Already clear of the field by the end of Lauriston Road he was never to be headed and although Marco Mazzotta and Brandon Reid seemed to be limiting the damage to about 30 metres after two laps of the "top", the next time the officials saw him he was exactly one minute clear of the second man.

Marco Mazzotta unfortunately had a bad run, having had a hard week's work up in Scotland and little sleep. He only produced 17:07, when beforehand he had beaten Brandon in the "five and three quarters" and also by 4 seconds at Chingford.
Belgrave's favourite sons of Italy, Marcello Bizio and Marco Mazzotta, pictured above, have both contributed to our Club's success in League and Cup by competing in the steeplechase.
